$schema: Last successfully verified notice. Failed attempts are reported outside this file and never advance verifiedAt.
headline: The car boot has finished for the 2026 season. It will return in March 2027.
detail: Once the new season starts, Apps Court Farm posts each week's notice at the top of its own car boot page, and 01932 244 822 has a recorded message saying whether the sale is on.
sourceLabel: Apps Court Farm: Car Boot page
lastCheckNote: Set by hand on 26 November 2026 at the site owner's instruction. From 20 November the farm's page carried a season-end notice in place of its weekly Sunday notice; the automated check reads the page (HTTP 200) but does not parse that wording, so it refused every run. Until seasonReturnsISO (1 March 2027) decide.mjs never replaces this record: an unrecognised notice is the expected off-season state and does not alert; any weekly notice alerts without writing. From 1 March the first weekly notice the check recognises replaces it.
